title: Memoize Any Function
hints: Cache results in a dictionary that the closure captures.
Pass the memoised function into `body` so recursive calls also go through the cache.
`if let hit = cache.value[input] { return hit }; let result = body(recurse.value!, input); cache.value[input] = result`.
jsBridge: Memoising with a captured dictionary is the same closure trick as a JS `memoize`. The recursion-friendly signature (`body` receives the memoised function) is the Y-combinator pattern, with generics keeping it typed.
